description: Three 3/2 core frames with an LFE channel and an XXCH extension whose frame header CRC-16 fails in the second.

skip.ffprobe: ffmpeg's decoder rejects the XXCH stub, whose channel set data is filler (dca_core.c: 'DSYNC check failed')
skip.decode: The XXCH channel set data is filler, which ffmpeg rejects at its DSYNC check; the frame whose header CRC-16 fails is not an XXCH frame to it at all ('XXCH sync word not found'), where the analyzer keeps the extension and reports dts.crc-mismatch
